title: Tanguat Language (TBS) – L1 & L2 Speakers, Status, Map ...
text: Tanguat is a stable indigenous language of Papua New Guinea. It belongs to the Ramu-Lower Sepik language family. Direct evidence is lacking, but the language is thought to be used as a first language by all in the ethnic community. It is not known to be taught in schools.
